usage: The word 「圓形」 is a noun meaning a circular or round shape.
It is commonly used to describe the shape of objects, patterns, or drawings.
In everyday Cantonese, 「圓形」 can be used when talking about things that are round, such as tables, plates, or signs.
It is also commonly used in geometry or classroom contexts when naming and comparing shapes.
「圓形」 can sometimes describe shape more generally than a strict mathematical circle, depending on context.
